explanation: Zero at every D1 and GO step, and at D2 it is nonzero only on a2 trials (very rarely a1) where the previous trial was rewarded and the trial before it was not a rare transition: the first such trial of a run (often right after switching to a2 or after an unrewarded trial) is about 10 (6-7 before trial 40), then it drops on later trials of the run to about 8, 7, 6, 5 and stays near 4-5 even after one unrewarded trial. It goes back to 0 on the trial right after any rare transition, on a2 trials that follow an unrewarded trial with no active run, and on almost all a1 trials.
